brief.title: Alien Draft Seal: A Clear Look at a Small-Gap Weather-Stripping Option
brief.hook: Cold air around a door gap? Here's a quick look at Alien Draft Seal.
key_points: Alien Draft Seal is an adhesive-backed transparent silicone weather-stripping product.
The supplied product facts describe three rolls with approximately 49 feet of material in total.
The footage illustrates the product and application steps; it does not prove draft reduction or energy savings.
Fit and surface compatibility matter; measure the gap and check the product instructions.
brief.core_message: A concise, source-led product preview that helps viewers understand what Alien Draft Seal is and why fit matters.
brief.cta: Measure first and check whether the strip suits the gap and surface.
brief.target_audience: US homeowners and renters considering a low-profile option for suitable small gaps around doors or windows.
reference_material: B08S3M2HKL-project-review.zip: visually inspected supplied video clips

concept_options.title: A Clear Strip for Suitable Gaps

concept_options.visual_approach: A 15-second source-led reveal using existing door-gap, package, strip-detail, and application footage.

concept_options.title: How the Strip Is Intended to Be Applied
concept_options.visual_approach: Use existing door-edge and strip footage to illustrate measure, prepare, position, and check-fit steps.
key_points: Check door movement and latch clearance.

concept_options.title: Is This Weather Stripping Right for Your Gap?
concept_options.hook: Not every gap is a match.
concept_options.visual_approach: Use supplied package and application clips with simple limitation-led overlays.
key_points: Adhesive compatibility and surface preparation matter.
Not a repair for damaged frames or large irregular gaps.
